_note: Hike-to terrain, gathered Nov 2026 from resort guides, Aspen Sojourner, OnTheSnow, Powderhounds, FATMAP route notes and trip reports. Times and gains vary by source and day: shown as 'about', and always 'check the resort's daily report'.

highlands.name: Highland Bowl
highlands.snowcat: 条件允许时有免费雪猫，从 Loge Peak 顶送到第一个门，能省大约三分之一的路
highlands.snowcatEn: When conditions allow, a free snowcat runs from the top of Loge Peak to the first gate, saving about a third of the walk
highlands.zhWhy: 科罗拉多最有名的徒步滑雪：沿山脊的靴印台阶走上去，山顶挂着经幡，下面是整个 Highland Bowl。
highlands.enWhy: Colorado's best-known hike-to: up the ridge on the boot-packed steps to prayer flags on the summit, the whole bowl below.
tips: 第一次最好跟走过的人一起
台阶很窄，按自己的节奏走，别跟着别人冲
山顶风大，留件厚外套在包里
整个碗都是雪崩地形：救援三件套（信标、铲子、探杆）建议带，不强制
tipsEn: Go the first time with someone who has done it
The steps are narrow: keep your own pace
It's windy on top: keep a warm layer in your pack
The whole bowl is avalanche terrain: a beacon, shovel and probe are advised, not required

abasin.name: Upper East Wall
abasin.zhWhy: 只能走上去的双黑道，大约二月才开，要做雪崩控制。
abasin.enWhy: Double-black terrain you can only walk to; it usually opens around February, after avalanche work.
tips: 看当天开没开：门口有牌子
tipsEn: Check it's open: the gate is signed
It's steep gullies on the way down

abasin.name: Steep Gullies
abasin.zhWhy: 从 Pallavicini 旁边的门进去的陡沟，滑完要走 20–30 分钟回 Pallavicini 缆车。
abasin.enWhy: Steep chutes through a gate by Pallavicini; after them it's a 20–30 minute walk back to the lift.
tipsEn: Save some legs for the walk back
Often opens late in the season

winterpark.name: Vasquez Cirque
winterpark.snowcat: 可以坐雪猫 Cirque Sled，在 Panoramic Express 顶上一点上车
winterpark.snowcatEn: Or ride the Cirque Sled snowcat, which loads just above the Panoramic Express
winterpark.zhWhy: Parsenn Bowl 后面像野雪一样的大冰斗，先滑行加走大约 1.6 公里过去。
winterpark.enWhy: A backcountry-like cirque behind Parsenn Bowl, a skate and walk of about a mile from the top of Panoramic.
tips: 一般二月中下旬才开，看门口的牌子
出来是很长的平路，单板要带速度，回 Eagle Wind / Wild Spur
tipsEn: It usually opens mid to late February: check the gate
The way out is a long runout: carry speed on a board

snowmass.name: Hanging Valley Wall
snowmass.zhWhy: Snowmass 最难的地形之一：陡壁、树林、悬崖。
snowmass.enWhy: Some of Snowmass's hardest terrain: steeps, trees and cliffs.
tips: 下午 2:30 左右关门，早点去
tipsEn: The gate closes around 2:30 pm: go early
It often opens late and closes early

steamboat.name: Morningside hike-to chutes
steamboat.zhWhy: 缆车顶走五分钟，就是几条短而陡的雪沟和 Christmas Tree Bowl 的稀疏林子。
steamboat.enWhy: A five-minute walk from the lift to short, steep chutes and the open glades of Christmas Tree Bowl.
tips: 很短，但有几步是陡的，板夹在手里
tipsEn: Short, but a few steps are steep: carry the board

copper.name: Tucker Mountain
copper.zhWhy: 以前要坐雪猫或沿 Copper Bowl 西脊走上去，2019 年起有 Three Bears 缆车。朝北，雪保存得久。
copper.enWhy: Once a snowcat or a hike up Copper Bowl's west ridge; since 2019 the Three Bears lift reaches it. North-facing, it holds snow.

alta.name: Baldy Chutes
alta.zhWhy: Alta 最有名的徒步：从 Sugarloaf 顶沿 East Baldy Traverse 过去，再沿靴印台阶走上 Mount Baldy 的山脊，下面是几条又窄又陡的雪沟。
alta.enWhy: Alta's best-known hike: from the top of Sugarloaf along the East Baldy Traverse, then up the boot-packed steps onto Mount Baldy's ridge, with narrow, steep chutes below.
tips: 要做完雪崩控制才开：看门口的牌子
台阶很窄，按自己的节奏走
下面的雪沟很陡，只适合专家
Alta 只许双板：这条线是给滑双板的人的
tipsEn: It opens only after avalanche work: check the gate
The steps are narrow: keep your own pace
The chutes below are steep: experts only
Alta is skiers only: this line is for skiers
